title: Linguistic Survey of India, Vol. IX, Part II: Rajasthani and Gujarati
author: Sir George Abraham Grierson
scope: Foundational classification establishing Rajasthani as an independent Indo-Aryan language group distinct from Western Hindi, cataloging Marwari, Mewari, Dhundhari, Harauti, and Malvi.

title: A Scheme for the Bardic and Historical Survey of Rajputana
author: Dr. Luigi Pio Tessitori
scope: Monumental exploration of Old Western Rajasthani (Maru-Gurjar), Dingal manuscripts, Charani poetry, and epigraphic records.

title: राजस्थानी सबद कोस (Rajasthani Sabad Kos - 9 Volumes)
author: पद्मश्री सीताराम लालस (Padma Shri Sita Ram Lalas)
scope: The monumental unabridged lexicon of the Rajasthani language cataloging over 200,000 unique lemmas, etymologies, and dialectal usages over 40 years of field research.

title: राजस्थani लोक-साहित्य (Rajasthani Lok-Sahitya)
author: डॉ. कन्हैयालाल सहल (Dr. K. L. Sahal)
scope: Definitive analytical study of Rajasthani proverbs (कहावतें), folk riddles (आडी/पहेलियाँ), folk ballads, and oral narrative arts.

title: बातां री फुलवारी (14 Volumes)
author: विजयदान देथा (Vijaydan Detha)
scope: Exhaustive compilation and literary preservation of thousands of Rajasthani folktales, legends, and oral traditions.
